input_policy: Only original question/prompt and declared dates/group. Published Answer and all other models predictions are excluded. No external submission performed.
timing: Original forecast deadlines are in2025 and precede the current model. A run now is a retrospective historical-question condition with possible parameter knowledge of outcomes, not an on-time native submission or uncontaminated future-forecast score.
ground_truth_policy: Use fixed published references for native-reference comparisons; personally verify consequential outcome/definition disagreements from primary records. Do not invoke the publisher LLM extraction/judging agents or another LLM grader.
